result.title: What is a Digital Embassy?
result.description:
Every country wants a stake in AI. Few have the infrastructure to compete alone. Digital embassies solve this: a country can have its digital systems hosted abroad, while having them governed by its own laws. 

The result: AI capability without giving up sovereignty.

Learn more in our recent white paper: https://www.weforum.org/publications/ai-infrastructure-in-the-age-of-sovereignty-requirements-strategies-and-a-trusted-framework-for-digital-embassies/ 

#InnovateScaleImpact #DigitalEmbassies #AI #DataSovereignty

result.title: How can new graduates prepare for the workplace as AI replaces entry level jobs
result.description:
This year’s graduates are entering a very different workplace from their predecessors. As employers integrate AI across organizations, the market for entry-level jobs is changing fast. 

How can #graduates prepare for this fast-changing world? Carina Cortez, Chief People Officer at AI-workforce platform Cornerstone OnDemand, and Maria Flynn, President and CEO of Jobs For The Future, share their insights.

result.title: AMNC26: What just happened at the Summer Davos?
result.description:
The Chinese port city of Dalian just hosted the 14th Annual Meeting of the New Champions - AMNC26 - often known as the Summer Davos.
Innovating at scale was the official theme, and we heard lots on that - but also geopolitics, not least the rivalry between China and the US. On this episode we get a flavour of the discussions and hear from the people at the World Economic Forum who are working on the big issues throughout the year.

result.title: Ideas on the Move: Andrew Forrest
result.description:
"The technology is there. What is lacking now is leadership."

Andrew Forrest joined us in Dalian for Ideas on the Move with a message aimed at political leaders: the solutions to the climate transition already exist. What's missing isn't innovation - it's courage.

Riding through Summer Davos on an electric golf cart, he made the point in real time: the efficient, scalable alternatives are already here. The barrier isn't technical, it's the will to implement and the policy to scale.

His challenge to leaders: you can go down in history as the one who made this happen.

#AMNC26 #IdeasOnTheMove @FortescueGlobal

result.title: Ideas on the Move: Soichi Noguchi
result.description:
"Don't let ambition become self-sacrifice”

@astrosoichi on what space taught him about ambition, limits, and readjusting to life on the ground - which he says was the hardest part.

As an overachiever, he says, you push to do more than you can handle. Eventually something gives, be it your health, your relationships, or your daily life. 

His advice to the next generation: don't let that something be you.
